days.title: Strength foundations
steps: Warm up: 5 min brisk walk or easy bike, then 10 bodyweight squats, 10 alternating reverse lunges and 10 arm circles each way.
Goblet squat 2 × 8; dumbbell Romanian deadlift 2 × 8; incline push-up 2 × 8; one-arm dumbbell row 2 × 10 per side; standing calf raise 2 × 12; plank 2 × 25 sec (rest 45 sec).

Choose a load that leaves 2–3 good reps in reserve (RPE 6–7). Rest 90 sec between sets. Increase by the smallest available increment only when all reps are controlled; keep loads lighter during recovery and taper weeks.
Cool down: 5 min easy walk, then 30 sec each calf, hip-flexor and chest stretch per side.

days.title: Station skills
steps: Warm up: 5 min brisk walk or easy bike, then 10 bodyweight squats, 10 alternating reverse lunges and 10 arm circles each way.

2 rounds, in this order: SkiErg 200 m; sled push 12.5 m; sled pull 12.5 m; burpee broad jumps 10 m; row 200 m; farmers carry 40 m; sandbag lunges 10 m; 8 wall balls. Rest 60 sec between stations and 2 min between rounds.

No equipment?
